212(a)(6)(A)(i).name: Present without admission or parole
212(a)(6)(A)(i).description: Alien present in the US without being admitted or paroled, or who arrived at a place not designated by an immigration officer
212(a)(6)(A)(i).source: INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i); USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 7, Part L, Ch. 3

212(a)(9)(A)(i).name: Prior removal, reentry without admission
212(a)(9)(A)(i).description: Alien previously ordered removed who entered or attempted to enter without being admitted
212(a)(9)(A)(i).source: INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i); USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 7, Part L, Ch. 3

212(a)(6)(C)(i).name: Misrepresentation or fraud
212(a)(6)(C)(i).description: Alien who sought admission or benefit through fraud or willful misrepresentation of a material fact
212(a)(6)(C)(i).source: INA 212(a)(6)(C)(i); USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 7, Part L, Ch. 3
